# All options

*Generated by `tools/gen_options_doc.py` from each stage's argument parser and schema; `chimes-agent <stage> --describe` prints the same schema. Every stage also accepts:*

| option | meaning |
|---|---|
| `--output-dir` | Where the stage writes; remembers inputs (idempotent), `--force` to redo. |
| `--json-in` | Read inputs from a JSON file (keys = option names with underscores); JSON wins over flags. |
| `--json-out` | Write the result JSON here instead of stdout. |
| `--describe` | Print the stage's schema and exit. |
| `--force` | Re-run even if this output directory holds a finished run. |
| `--dry-run` | Submitting stages only: render the job script without submitting. |

## `setup`

Build/fetch chimes_lsq, chimes_calculator, LAMMPS, and Quantum ESPRESSO for a machine.

Reference: [setup](setup.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--component` | array |  | Which component to build (repeatable). Default: all. |
| `--machine` | string |  | Machine profile to build for: a built-in name (dane, generic, stampede3) or a path to your own profile YAML (required unless --status). |
| `--qe-version` | string |  | Override the pinned QE release tag. |
| `--status` | flag | `False` | Report what's already installed (from deps/installed.json) and exit; no build. |
| `--ref` | array |  | REPO=COMMIT (repeatable): check a vendored fork out at this commit, branch or tag instead of its pin, for this call. |
| `--init-profile` | string |  | Write a machine profile YAML at this path (partitions, cores and accounts detected from Slurm) and exit. |
| `--account` | string |  | --init-profile: fallback Slurm account (CHIMES_ACCOUNT still wins). |
| `--debug-partition` | string |  |  |
| `--batch-partition` | string |  |  |
| `--cores-per-node` | integer |  |  |
| `--scratch` | string |  | --init-profile: shared scratch directory for job I/O. |
| `--modules` | array |  | --init-profile: modules to load in jobs and builds. |
| `--hosttype` | string |  | --init-profile: the forks' modfile name (codes/*/modfiles/<hosttype>.mod); default none. |

## `data-search`

Search open DFT datasets (ColabFit catalog) for a chemical system; downloads no configurations.

Reference: [data-search](data-search.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--elements` | array |  | **required.** Target chemical system, e.g. ["Cu", "Zr"]. |
| `--methods` | array |  | Keep datasets containing any of these methods (exact ColabFit labels, e.g. "DFT-PBE"). Omit to list all and see what exists. |
| `--no-require-forces` | flag | `True` |  |
| `--include-nonperiodic` | flag | `True` | Only datasets with 3D-periodic configurations. |
| `--include-overlap` | flag | `False` |  |
| `--limit` | integer | `25` |  |
| `--refresh` | flag | `False` | Refetch the catalog (cached for 30 days). |

## `data-fetch`

Fetch configurations for a chemical system from ColabFit or local DFT files into one .xyzf + provenance.

Reference: [data-fetch](data-fetch.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--source` | string/array |  | **required.** `colabfit:<repo_id>`, or a path / list of paths to local DFT output or .xyzf. |
| `--elements` | array |  | **required.**  |
| `--composition-rule` | one of `subset`, `exact` | `subset` |  |
| `--method` | string |  | ColabFit method label to keep (e.g. "DFT-PBE"); required when matches span several. |
| `--max-frames` | integer | `5000` | Uniform random sample cap; null = everything. |
| `--all-frames` | integer | `5000` | Uniform random sample cap; null = everything. |
| `--count-only` | flag | `False` | Report matching counts per method without downloading coordinates. |
| `--max-scan-files` | integer |  | Only scan the first N parquet files of a very large dataset (count and sample then cover only those). |
| `--label-policy` | one of `source`, `relabel` | `source` |  |
| `--level-of-theory` | string |  | Local sources only: e.g. "QE PBE PAW, ecutwfc 60 Ry". Recorded in provenance. |
| `--seed` | integer | `42` |  |

## `data-generate`

Generate strained/rattled/substituted supercells (unlabeled) for QE labeling.

Reference: [data-generate](data-generate.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--prototypes` | array |  | ase.build.bulk kwargs, e.g. {"name": "Cu", "crystalstructure": "fcc", "a": 3.61} or {"name": "Zr", "crystalstructure": "hcp", "a": 3.23, "c": 5.15}. |
| `--seeds` | array |  | Structure files (.xyzf or ASE-readable); every frame is a seed. |
| `--compositions` | array |  | Random-substitution targets, e.g. [{"Cu": 0.5, "Zr": 0.5}]; omit to keep seed chemistry. |
| `--min-width-ang` | number | `8.0` | Minimum perpendicular cell width of each supercell. |
| `--max-atoms` | integer | `128` | Skip seeds whose supercell would exceed this (QE cost grows ~N^3). |
| `--volume-strains` | array | `[-0.08, -0.04, 0.0, 0.04, 0.08]` | Fractional volume changes. |
| `--rattle-std-ang` | array | `[0.05, 0.15]` |  |
| `--n-rattle` | integer | `2` | Rattled copies per (seed, composition, strain, rattle_std). |
| `--seed` | integer | `42` |  |

## `data-curate`

Filter, analyze, subsample and split fetched pools into a ChIMES base dataset + data_manifest.json.

Reference: [data-curate](data-curate.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--frames` | array |  | **required.** .xyzf pools; provenance.json beside each is used when present. |
| `--elements` | array |  | **required.**  |
| `--min-distance-ang` | number | `0.5` | Drop frames with any interatomic distance below this (unphysical). |
| `--max-force-ev-ang` | number | `50.0` | Drop frames with any force component norm above this. |
| `--energy-outlier-mad` | number | `8.0` | Drop frames whose per-atom energy residual is more than this many scaled MADs from the median (and at least energy_outlier_floor away); null disables. |
| `--no-energy-outliers` | number | `8.0` | Drop frames whose per-atom energy residual is more than this many scaled MADs from the median (and at least energy_outlier_floor away); null disables. |
| `--energy-outlier-floor` | number | `1.0` | eV/atom. A residual must also be at least this far from the median to count: broken labels are off by ~eV/atom, while a tight dataset's MAD can be small enough to flag legitimate strained frames. |
| `--no-dedupe` | flag | `True` |  |
| `--natoms-min` | integer |  |  |
| `--natoms-max` | integer |  |  |
| `--require-orthorhombic` | flag | `False` |  |
| `--max-volume-ratio` | number | `3.0` | Drop frames whose volume per atom exceeds this multiple of the pool median: clusters/molecules in vacuum boxes, which general databases include but a bulk model should not fit. null keeps them. |
| `--keep-vacuum` | number | `3.0` | Drop frames whose volume per atom exceeds this multiple of the pool median: clusters/molecules in vacuum boxes, which general databases include but a bulk model should not fit. null keeps them. |
| `--coverage-cutoff-ang` | number | `6.0` | Pair-distance analysis radius. |
| `--target-size` | integer |  | Subsample to this many frames before splitting (see selection). |
| `--selection` | one of `fps`, `quests` | `fps` | How target_size frames are chosen: fps (composition/energy farthest-point) or quests (entropy-maximizing in QUESTS environment space; needs `pip install quests`). |
| `--holdout-fraction` | number | `0.2` | Composition-stratified holdout; null = no split. |
| `--split-by` | one of `group`, `frame` | `group` | Hold out whole groups of correlated frames (relaxation paths, closely spaced MD frames; see dataset-select) or independent frames. group avoids near-copies of training frames in the holdout, which overstates accuracy. |
| `--no-holdout` | number | `0.2` | Composition-stratified holdout; null = no split. |
| `--allow-mixed-theory` | flag | `False` | Permit merging pools from different datasets or levels of theory. Energies from different DFT setups are not comparable; only use after checking settings match. |
| `--seed` | integer | `42` |  |

## `fingerprint`

Cluster-graph fingerprints: dataset coverage (D^2), per-frame novelty (D_j^2), novel frames for active learning.

Reference: [fingerprint](fingerprint.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--params` | string |  | **required.** params.txt whose cutoffs and Morse lambdas define the clusters. |
| `--reference-xyzf` | string |  | **required.** Reference set, e.g. the training data. |
| `--candidates-xyzf` | string |  | Set to compare: MD frames, a new pool, the md-check harvest. |
| `--orders` | array |  | Body orders in the fingerprint. Default: the model's (2, plus 3/4 if it has them). |
| `--max-frames` | integer | `500` | Cap per set (evenly spaced). |
| `--max-clusters` | integer | `5000` | Clusters per order per frame used for the dissimilarity histogram (random subset above this). |
| `--alpha` | number | `0.1` | Significance level of the chi-squared tests (the paper used 0.1). |
| `--structure-weight` | number |  | The paper's alpha in [0, 1]: weight of structure vs composition. Default: the type-agnostic fingerprint. |
| `--structure-weights` | array |  | Extra alphas to report D2 and novelty for (a diagnosis sweep). |
| `--descriptor` | one of `mass`, `number` | `mass` | Element descriptor for the composition term. |
| `--workers` | integer | `1` |  |
| `--machine` | string |  | Run as one Slurm job (all frames in parallel on one node). |
| `--queue` | string | `debug` |  |
| `--walltime-hours` | number | `1.0` |  |

## `quests`

QUESTS entropy/diversity of a dataset, per-environment novelty (dH) of candidates, entropy-maximizing selection.

Reference: [quests](quests.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--reference-xyzf` | string |  | **required.**  |
| `--candidates-xyzf` | string |  |  |
| `--descriptor` | one of `single`, `multi` | `single` |  |
| `--k` | integer | `32` | Neighbors per environment (QUESTS default 32). |
| `--cutoff` | number | `5.0` | Å, weight-function cutoff (QUESTS default 5). |
| `--bandwidth` | number |  | Kernel bandwidth; default QUESTS' (0.015). |
| `--max-frames` | integer | `2000` | Cap per set (evenly spaced). |
| `--select` | integer |  | Pick this many candidate frames by greedy entropy gain. |
| `--dh-threshold` | number |  | dH above which an environment is novel. Default: the reference's own 99th-percentile self-dH. |
| `--rank-by` | one of `max`, `mean` | `max` | Frame novelty = max (most novel environment) or mean dH over its atoms. |
| `--no-entropy-curve` | flag | `True` | H over nested subsets of the reference (12.5 % … 100 %). |
| `--no-plot` | flag | `True` |  |

## `dataset-select`

FPS / random / stratified-holdout sampling over a frame pool.

Reference: [dataset-select](dataset-select.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--frames` | string |  | **required.** Path to a .xyzf frame pool. |
| `--method` | one of `fps`, `random`, `stratified_holdout`, `quests` |  | **required.** quests = greedy entropy-maximizing subset in QUESTS environment space (needs `pip install quests`). |
| `--n-select` | integer |  | Size of the selected/train set; alternative to holdout_fraction. |
| `--holdout-fraction` | number |  | Fraction of the pool held out; alternative to n_select. |
| `--seed` | integer | `42` |  |
| `--descriptor` | one of `composition`, `energy`, `composition_energy` | `composition` | fps only. |
| `--split-by` | one of `group`, `frame` | `group` | stratified_holdout only. group = hold out whole groups of correlated frames (relaxation paths, closely spaced MD frames) so the holdout is not a near-copy of training data; frame = independent frames (the old behavior). |
| `--group-rmsd` | number | `0.3` | Å. Frames with identical atom order, matching cells and a minimum-image RMS displacement below this are linked into one group. |
| `--group-cell-tol` | number | `0.03` | Relative tolerance on cell vectors for linking frames. |

## `qe-relabel`

Submit QE single-point (SCF) labeling jobs; --collect converts finished output to .xyzf.

Reference: [qe-relabel](qe-relabel.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--structure-xyzf` | string |  | Unlabeled configs (positions/box; forces/energy fields ignored). |
| `--frame-indices` | array |  | Which frames to submit; default all. |

| `--ecutrho` | number |  | Ry; default 4*ecutwfc |
| `--kpoints` | array | `[1, 1, 1]` | One fixed grid for every frame; ignored when kspacing is set. |
| `--kspacing` | number |  | Max reciprocal-space spacing in 1/Angstrom (2*pi included, VASP KSPACING convention); picks a grid per frame, n_i = ceil(|b_i|/kspacing). Use this when cell sizes vary, so every frame gets the same k-point density. |
| `--smearing` | string | `gaussian` |  |
| `--degauss` | number | `0.01` |  |
| `--conv-thr` | number | `1e-08` |  |
| `--machine` | string |  |  |
| `--queue` | string | `batch` |  |
| `--walltime-hours` | number | `4.0` |  |
| `--nodes` | integer | `1` |  |
| `--ntasks-per-node` | integer |  |  |
| `--collect` | string |  | Path to a previously-submitted work dir; switches to collect mode. |

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--data-manifest` | string |  | data_manifest.json from data-curate (supplies train_xyzf and elements). |
| `--train-xyzf` | string |  |  |
| `--elements` | array |  |  |
| `--r-max` | number | `8.0` | Analysis radius (A); also the largest 2-body cutoff proposed. |

## `hyper-search`

Staged search over cutoffs, Morse lambdas and 2b/3b/4b orders; picks the cheapest near-best model on holdout error.

Reference: [hyper-search](hyper-search.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--data-manifest` | string |  | From data-curate: train/holdout paths, elements, fitener. |
| `--train-xyzf` | string |  |  |
| `--holdout-xyzf` | string |  |  |
| `--elements` | array |  |  |
| `--hyper-analysis` | string |  | hyper_analysis.json; computed if omitted. |
| `--stages` | array | `["2b", "3b", "3b_pairs", "4b", "smoothing", "exclude", "lambda", "refine", "alpha", "stress"]` |  |
| `--four-body` | one of `off`, `on`, `auto` | `auto` |  |
| `--orders-2b` | array | `[8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18]` |  |
| `--orders-3b` | array | `[4, 6, 8, 10]` |  |
| `--orders-4b` | array | `[2, 3]` |  |
| `--four-body-solvers` | array |  | Solvers the 4b stage compares; each extra solver refits the 3-body baseline too, so every 4-body point is compared like for like, and doubles the (expensive) 4-body builds. Default: only the search solver. Add blocklasso to test whether raw lassolars is hiding 4-body signal (on Cu-Zr it was not: blocklasso was worse everywhere). |
| `--exclude-rounds` | integer | `2` | Greedy rounds of the exclude stage (each round tries removing every remaining 3-/4-body cluster type). |
| `--s-maxim-2b` | array |  | Default: hyper-analyze candidates. |
| `--s-maxim-3b` | array |  |  |
| `--s-maxim-4b` | array |  |  |
| `--lambda-scales` | array | `[0.9, 1.0, 1.1]` |  |
| `--prefer` | one of `cheaper`, `richer` | `cheaper` | Among statistically tied points: cheaper = lowest estimated MD cost (a final model); richer = most coefficients (a model that will go through active learning: the literature errs toward complexity before AL and prunes once the data is final, Lindsey et al. 2025). richer also skips the exclusion stage. |
| `--weights-preset` | string | `uniform` | Fitting weights for every fit (weights stage presets: uniform, al_driver, lindsey2020, carbon2_large, hierarchical2026). Matters when energies (or stresses) are fitted alongside forces. Changing it refits every point. |
| `--stress-weights` | array | `[1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]` | Stress-row weights the `stress` stage tries (only when fitting stresses). |
| `--alphas` | array | `[1e-07, 1e-06, 1e-05, 0.0001, 0.001]` | Regularization strengths the `alpha` stage re-solves the chosen basis with (LASSO/ridge solvers). The cheapest statistically tied model wins, and MD cost counts nonzero coefficients, so ties go to sparser models. |
| `--cv-folds` | integer | `0` | k > 1: score every point by k-fold cross-validation over the training frames (held-out frames get row weight 0 in the same design matrix; correlated frames share a fold; closest contacts stay in training). ~k times the statistical power of a holdout; the external holdout is still reported as ext_holdout_*. |
| `--cv-seed` | integer | `0` |  |
| `--smoothings` | array | `["TERSOFF 0.5", "TERSOFF 0.75"]` | FCUTTYP values the `smoothing` stage compares with the current one (literature: TERSOFF 0.5-0.75 for many-body models). |
| `--smoothing` | string | `CUBIC` | fm_setup.in FCUTTYP for every fit: CUBIC (chimes_lsq default) or 'TERSOFF <f_O>' with 0 < f_O < 1. The cubic form multiplies one smoothing factor per cluster distance and shrinks 3-/4-body terms; published many-body ChIMES models use TERSOFF 0.5-0.75 (Lindsey et al., JCP 153, 134117, 2020). Changing it refits every point. |
| `--objective` | one of `auto`, `force`, `force+energy` | `auto` | auto = force+energy when energies are fitted, else force. |
| `--energy-weight` | number | `0.1` | Score per kcal/mol/atom of energy RMSE, for objective force+energy. |
| `--tolerance` | number | `0.03` | Accept a cheaper model scoring within this fraction of the best, or within one bootstrap standard error of it if that is larger. |
| `--min-gain` | number | `0.05` | four_body=auto runs 4b only if 3b improved the score by at least this fraction. |
| `--min-signal` | number | `1e-09` | Flag 3-/4-body terms whose median column norm is below this fraction of the 2-body median: they can only act through very large coefficients. Flagged, not excluded, unless exclude_inert. |
| `--exclude-inert` | flag | `False` |  |
| `--max-fit-seconds` | number | `600` | Abandon a fit whose design-matrix build exceeds this (reported as status timeout). |
| `--max-param-ratio` | number | `0.5` | Coefficients per equation above which a point is never chosen. |
| `--fitener` | boolean |  | Default: data_manifest fit_hints.fitener. |
| `--fitstrs` | string/boolean |  | Fit stresses: ALL (full tensor), true (diagonal) or false. Default: data_manifest fit_hints.fitstrs. Use with a weights preset that weights stresses (hierarchical2026, carbon2_large). |
| `--algorithm` | string | `lassolars` |  |
| `--alpha` | number | `1e-05` |  |
| `--masses` | object |  |  |
| `--workers` | integer | `4` |  |
| `--machine` | string |  | Submit the whole search as one Slurm job on this machine. |
| `--queue` | string | `batch` |  |
| `--walltime-hours` | number | `4.0` |  |
| `--cores` | integer |  | Cores to request with --machine; default = the largest stage's fit count (capped at a node). Charged hours scale with this. |

## `fm-setup-gen`

Generate fm_setup.in from typed parameters (elements, cutoffs, order, fit flags).

Reference: [fm-setup-gen](fm-setup-gen.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--trjfile` | string |  | **required.** Path to the .xyzf training trajectory (written as-is into TRJFILE; use an absolute path). |
| `--nframes` | integer |  | **required.**  |
| `--elements` | array |  | **required.** Comma-separated, e.g. C,H |
| `--order` | object |  | **required.** {"2": N, "3": N, "4": N (optional)} |
| `--default-s-minim` | float | `1.0` |  |
| `--default-s-maxim` | float | `6.0` |  |
| `--default-morse-lambda` | float | `1.5` |  |
| `--pair-cutoffs` | object |  | "El1-El2" -> [s_minim, s_maxim]; falls back to --default-s-minim/--default-s-maxim for unlisted pairs. |
| `--morse-lambda` | object |  | "El1-El2" -> morse lambda; falls back to --default-morse-lambda. |

| `--fitstrs` | string | `false` |  |
| `--fitcoul` | flag | `False` |  |
| `--fitpovr` | flag | `False` |  |
| `--wraptrj` | boolean | `True` |  |
| `--nlayers` | integer | `1` |  |
| `--chbtype` | string | `MORSE` |  |
| `--fcuttyp` | string | `CUBIC` |  |
| `--s-delta` | number | `0.01` |  |
| `--special-maxim-3b` | number |  | Overrides the 2-body S_MAXIM for all 3-body clusters (documented ChIMES practice: a shorter 3-body outer cutoff, the 1st non-bonded shell). |
| `--hyper-choice` | string |  | hyper_choice.json from hyper-search: fills elements, order, cutoffs, lambdas, exclusions, nlayers, fitener/fitstrs and smoothing (explicit inputs win; solver keys are ignored). Use it to refit the chosen model on new data, e.g. after al-merge. |
| `--special-maxim-3b-pairs` | object |  | Per-pair 3-body outer cutoffs {"A-B": r}: each pair of a triplet uses its own cutoff (SPECIAL 3B S_MAXIM: SPECIFIC). Takes precedence over special_maxim_3b. |
| `--special-maxim-4b` | number |  | Same, for 4-body clusters. |

| `--n-select` | integer | `20` | Most uncertain frames written to uncertain.xyzf. |

## `al-run`

Launch al_driver's main.py (active-learning loop) as a detached background process.

Reference: [al-run](al-run.md).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--work-dir` | string |  | An al_driver study directory (ALL_BASE_FILES/ already prepared). |
| `--config-py` | string |  | Path to a config.py to copy into work_dir; omit if work_dir/config.py already exists. |
| `--cycles` | array | `[0]` | ALC cycle indices to run, passed as main.py's argv. |
| `--python-bin` | string |  | Override which python runs main.py; default sys.executable. |
| `--status-of` | integer |  | PID to check instead of launching. |
| `--stop` | integer |  | PID to SIGTERM instead of launching. |
